description: Aggro Warrior on the ladder — prioritize cheap removal and tempo.

initialHand.note: Fireball (6 mana) is too slow vs Aggro. Almost always a mulligan.
Bloodmage Thalnos: decent — gives Spell Damage and draws a card. Situational keep.
Sen'jin (4 mana) is slightly slow; prefer cheaper taunts vs Warrior aggro.

description: Midrange Druid — you have the Coin. Look for 3-drops and early board presence.

initialHand.note: Sen'jin Shieldmasta slows their ramp and contests the board. Strong keep.
6-mana spell is far too slow for this matchup — always discard.
Thalnos + Coin gives you early Spell Damage value. Almost always keep.
Second copy of a 4-drop is mediocre — mulligan one of the two Sen'jins.

description: Control Mage — look for weapons and early pressure before they stabilize.

initialHand.note: Thalnos: decent draw and cycle — fine to keep if nothing better.
Never keep Fireball vs Control Mage — they out-value you. Always mulligan.
Sen'jin forces Mage to spend removal early — great tempo play. Keep.
